references.text: God reminds Israel of what He did to Egypt, just as Moses here reminds the people of what they saw in Egypt.
Describes the plagues and signs that the Lord performed against Pharaoh and Egypt, which Moses refers to here.
Israel witnessed the Lord's mighty act against the Egyptians at the Red Sea, something they were eyewitnesses to.
Moses reminds the people that they themselves saw God's signs and wonders in Egypt against Pharaoh.
The people are urged to remember what the Lord did to Pharaoh and all of Egypt, which they saw with their own eyes.
Moses reminds the children of Israel that they saw the Lord's deeds in Egypt against Pharaoh with their own eyes.
Moses gathers all Israel to speak to them, as he does here at the beginning of the covenant renewal.
Joshua reminds the people of what the Lord did in Egypt, which they had seen and heard from their fathers.
Stephen tells about Moses leading the people out and performing wonders and signs in Egypt.
